findings.rule: HARD: overload_start fires in the same 10 ms tick as the add_spawn that brings the living-add count to addsThreshold 7 (alive >= 7). Order within that tick: add_spawn, then burden_update p0 and p1 (n=7), then overload_start (playerIndex -1, damage 0), then the regular per-tick events. The count is the number of living adds, which equals the Burden stacks.
findings.evidence: Log A: adds spawn every 10 s from 10500, none die. At 70500 add 7 spawns, burden_update n=7 x2, then overload_start at 70500. No overload_start at n=5 or 6 (50500 and 60500). 1 of 1 occurrence. Client: getCelestialMaxHoldCount clamps holdCount to min(maxAlive, addsThreshold) (L1159404-1159450). NORMAL config addsThreshold 5 at L1159902.

findings.rule: Overload multiplies only the boss's auto-attack, by (1 + attackBuffMultiplier) = 6 for HARD. Damage = round(266866*6*(1-D/100)*(1+0.1n)). Add swings are NOT multiplied: they stay round(53373*(1-D/100)*(1+0.1n)). Block Fury, Burden and Judgment timing are unchanged. The UI text says '+{{pct}}% attack until the room thins out, so it hits {{mult}}x as hard' (pct 500, mult 6). Round 1's hypothesis 'boss, add and Judgment all x6' is wrong for adds. Judgment under overload is untested.

Overloaded add swings 12/12 exact without a multiplier: 6 on the tank at 58705 = round(53373*0.647*1.7), 6 on the Sentinel at 90734 = round(53373*1.7). Before 70500 the adds hit for 55252 (n=6); the ratio 58705/55252 = 1.7/1.6 is Burden alone. The one boss swing at 70990 was blocked. No Judgment fired during overload (next was due at 92480).

findings.mechanic: Why Oria had 0 Bulwark stacks in 3 logs: one stack player per fight
findings.rule: Stack sigils (Bulwark, Elusive, Sunder, Siegebreaker) are simulated for only ONE player per Celestial fight. bulwarkStacks/sunderStacks are that player's stacks: the self-stack slot is Bulwark, else Elusive. In round 1 and log A the stack player was OrionAF, who requested the start (grantedGlyphs g-riven/g-quick match OrionAF's drops). He runs Elusive Supremacy, not Bulwark, so Oria's equipped BULWARK_OF_THORNS (and her Iron Bastion glyph thorns) never ran. In log B the stack player was Tin can, who was 'ready' while OrionAF was not, with autoStart on, so Tin can's join most likely triggered the start. The cause is not sigil level, spec or ownership: Oria's sigilState.equippedSpecies includes BULWARK_OF_THORNS, and spec checks only apply to Mystics. Neither leader nor tank fits as the rule: B's leader is OrionAF but its stacks are the tank's, and A's tank is Oria but its stacks are OrionAF's.

Log A: after Oria died at 71510, OrionAF's evades (add_block p0 71790, player_block p0 72040) raise bulwarkStacks to 1, and each hit on him drops it to 0, as Elusive does (burn 2). Round 1: 0 stacks because OrionAF was never attacked. Log B: the stacks follow player 1's blocks, hits and boss hits exactly.

findings.mechanic: Tank HP bookkeeping with Bulwark and Earthwarden
findings.rule: cap = floor(round(S*(1-0.04n))*(1+0.08b+EW)). When stacks burn, HP may stay above cap: no immediate clamp, and regen and lifesteal only heal while HP < cap. HP = min(HP, cap(snapshot stacks)) is applied only when an enemy swing resolves on the tank (block or hit, Judgment included), before damage. Burden_update clamps to round(S*(1-0.04n)), ignoring both Bulwark and Earthwarden HP% (for example 39771372 -> 15880930 at 20500). Earthwarden's end does NOT clamp, unlike Iron Bastion. Regen reads the sheet HP only.

Per event: landed hit = flame+dark (657); hit taken (Judgment included) = 0.7*(earthen+dark) = 459.9; block = earthen+dark (657). Casts at 3130, 66790, 138320 and 232370.

findings.rule: Integer stacks on the boss, from the stack player's landed auto-attacks on the BOSS only. Hits on adds and the other player's hits add nothing. +1 per hit, capped at 8. Decay is sunderDecayTick with decayAccumMs: each 10 ms tick, after that tick's hits, acc += 10, and acc >= 1000/decayPerSecond removes 1 stack and subtracts the period. acc resets when stacks reach 0. decayPerSecond is 1.4 here (glyph override; the base is 1.75). There is no observable effect: the boss and adds have no DR, block, miss or blind to strip.

findings.rule: On every burden_update, HP = min(HP, round(sheetHp*(1-0.04n))). Round 1's 'when n falls, HP stays' is true only when HP is already below the new base.

findings.mechanic: Bonus max HP (Bulwark, Earthwarden) and its clamp timing
findings.rule: cap = floor(round(sheet*(1-0.04n)) * (1 + 0.08*bulwarkStacks + 1.0*EW)). Earthwarden adds no HP when cast. HP above the cap is not clamped when a stack is lost. It is clamped down to the cap at TICK-START stacks only on a tick where an enemy swing resolves against the tank (hit or block), before that swing. Ticks with only the tank's own attacks, DoTs or regen do not clamp. When Earthwarden ends there is no clamp. Regen and lifesteal heal only while HP < cap, and never pull HP down.
findings.evidence: L95 HP replay: 14539/14540 player-ticks. Clamping at Earthwarden end gives 4 misses. Clamping on every stack loss gives 317 misses. Clamping before each block only gives 120 misses. The single miss is 66790: Earthwarden is cast in the same tick as 2 add hits, and HP is set back to the start-of-tick clamp value 21542826 (+71688 = both hits undone). Hypothesis: the transform restores a stale HP snapshot from the tick's stat recompute.
findings.source: work2/hp.js (capMode m0, bulClamp tick, ewNoEndClamp); client recompute step L1088825-1088950
